{"m": "gpt-4o-mini", "msg": [{"content": "You compare short personal anecdotes by their underlying relational structure - the pattern of intentions, causes, deceptions, reversals, and outcomes among the people involved - NOT by their surface topic, setting, or vocabulary. Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
My neighbor was the grumpiest man on the block—complained about noise, never waved, gave disapproving looks. When my house caught fire at 2 AM, he was the first one outside with blankets and water. He called his son the firefighter before the dispatcher answered. He sat with my trembling kids until dawn.

CANDIDATE A:
The intern we'd written off as flighty and unfocused was present when our CEO had a seizure in a meeting. While executives panicked, she calmly directed everyone, provided first aid, and coordinated with paramedics. Her scattered demeanor masked a composed crisis responder.

CANDIDATE B:
My neighbor was the grumpiest man on the block—complained about noise, never waved, gave disapproving looks. When my house flooded during the storm, he watched from his window but didn't come over. The next day he complained that our emergency vehicles had blocked his driveway. Crisis confirmed his character.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:57"}
content: {"choice": "A", "reason": "Both stories reveal a surprising and positive transformation of a character previously perceived negatively, showcasing their true capabilities in a crisis."}
